answer: Each agent submits one verifier-named URL carrying the challenge hash to the Wayback Machine within 10 minutes, publishing its snapshot URL. The verifier fetches it from web.archive.org, checks the hash, the timestamp inside the window, and the URL against the ocean archive. One honest agent archives 1 URL for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must archive 10 URLs, so costs rise 10X in an onyx record no nebula can forge. A missing snapshot, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
